verbatim: Can you take your own recommended answer when appropriate? It might make this research less dependent on me looking at the screen.
effect: The coordinator takes its own recommended answer on pending definitions when the recommendation is clear. Each is recorded as a PD marked "coordinator under principal delegation", reversible by the principal, and reported in a plain summary. Still brought to the principal: anything without a clear recommendation, anything that reverses an earlier principal decision, anything that changes the program's goals or finish line, and any adoption the evidence argues against.
